In mathematics, a '''Inoue–Hirzebruch''' surface is a [[complex number|complex]] [[surface (mathematics)|surface]] with no [[meromorphic function]]s introduced by {{harvtxt|Inoue|1977}}. They have [[Kodaira dimension]] κ = −∞, and are non-algebraic [[surfaces of class VII]] with positive second [[Betti number]]. {{harvtxt|Sankaran|1987}} studied some higher-dimensional analogues.
